name: prooflens
description: ProofLens monorepo: FastAPI backend (src), Next.js web (apps/web), Expo mobile (apps/mobile).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,web,mobile -c blue,green,magenta "npm run backend:lan" "npm run web" "npm run mobile"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run web"
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently -k -n backend,mobile -c blue,magenta "npm run backend:lan" "npm run mobile"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && cd src && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'
